title: Adding And Subtracting Fractions — worked example

body.title: Adding And Subtracting Fractions — worked example
body.hook: We'll learn adding and subtracting fractions by studying one clear example first.

steps: Watch out: Adds numerators and denominators separately

body.misconception_check: Avoid this trap: Adds numerators and denominators separately

prompt:
You are a Year 5 maths tutor. Teach using WORKED EXAMPLE FIRST.

Skill: adding and subtracting fractions
Active misconception to address: Adds numerators and denominators separately
Teaching method: worked_example

Rules:
- Show one fully worked example step by step BEFORE any practice.
- Explicitly warn against this misconception: Adds numerators and denominators separately
- Then give 3 short practice questions.
- You MUST use these exact correct answers (do not invent different answers):
- example add_01: 3/5
- add_02: 3/7
- add_03: 1/2
- add_04: 5/6

Return JSON only with this shape:
{
  "title": "...",
  "method": "worked_example",
  "hook": "one sentence",
  "worked_example": {"problem": "...", "steps": ["..."], "answer": "..."},
  "misconception_check": "one sentence correcting the misconception",
  "practice": [{"id": "...", "prompt": "...", "answer": "..."}],
  "exit_ticket": {"prompt": "...", "answer": "..."}
}

Practice stems (use these; keep their answers exactly):
- id=add_02 | Calculate 4/7 − 1/7. | CORRECT_ANSWER=3/7
- id=add_03 | Calculate 1/4 + 1/4. | CORRECT_ANSWER=1/2
- id=add_04 | Calculate 2/3 + 1/6. | CORRECT_ANSWER=5/6
